semantic_label: node array fill: open the page property list, read the row and column counts and create or drop one node per grid cell
declaration: void __thiscall palette_safe_wave11_fill_node_array_005c7ff0(OpaquePageBuild* self, const std::uint32_t* expected, void* context, void* extra)

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x30
abi.return_contract: none; the target returns no value and EAX is not an answer

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: open the property list through the list getter 0x0067de30 and the open vtable slot 0x2c with the two seed words from the context
probe the page identifier 0x1f7d3cf3 through 0x006a12a0 and report through the mode manager when the probe fails
release the list and return when the probed identifier differs from the expected word
read the cell limit and offset through 0x006a0ae0 with 0xeeead734, the row and column counts through 0x006a07d0 with 0xf8e99c4f and the line and index arrays through 0x006a07d0 with 0x22c47931
read the threshold through 0x00410370 with 0x05383435 when the app props flag at +0x118 is non-zero
clamp the limit to the line count and report when the limit differs from the row count
for each cell, skip and report when the column is outside the column count at +0x50 or the row is outside the row count at +0x54
release the held node at the flat index, drop it when its +0x48 word exceeds the threshold and report when it equals the threshold

otherwise acquire a node through 0x00f473a0 with the size 0x54 and the tag 0x013eb430, construct it through 0x005c66a0, fill it through 0x005c6810 with the threshold and the extra, and store it at +0x70 through 0x005766e0
drop the new node and the replaced node, then release the list

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the column and row counts, the flag at +0x118 of the app props and the node array at +0x70
the app pointer at 0x015fd918 is dereferenced without a null test, so a null app is a latent fault in the original and the model keeps the same unguarded read
all thirteen ports are dependency-only, so the node creation is unverified in this package
the five property keys are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reports the list release only at the end; the assembly releases it on the early return after the identifier mismatch, so the corrected model keeps that release
the decompilation reports one drop of the held node; the assembly drops the held node on the threshold branch and again at the end of the cell, so the corrected model keeps both
the decompilation compares the limit against the row count before clamping; the assembly compares first, clamps against the line count second and only then reports, so the model keeps that order

The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
